title: 第020章 云家家宴第021章 白发老者

秦延军这边放弃了，回师傅那里的念头，随后又换了一个地方，坐了下来。
云家。
云梦蝶挂断电话，开心的说道：“爷爷，秦延军答应了，明天晚上过来赴宴。现在能告诉我是什么事情了吗？”
老爷子云开阳看着孙女急切的样子，忍住笑说道：“想让他过来把你们俩的事定下来，既然他已经答应了，接下来就请他的大师姐明晚一同过来赴宴，秦延军父母已经失踪，不知去向。目前为止，他也还没有同他爷爷相认，所以我们只能请他的师姐们过来做个见证。”
云金刚说道：“爸！前两天他的师兄师姐聚在一起就有四个，住在京城的已经回去了，荣威集团两位总裁都是他的师姐和师兄，我们是请一个，还是请两个？”
柳新梅敲了一下他的脑袋：“我说你当董事长，是不是脑袋也糊涂了？这件事，自然是告诉他的大师姐，他们来几个人，自然是他们自己的安排。难道？你还要强行让人家几个人来？”
“夫人，我这也是关心咱们的女儿，一下子脑袋没有转过弯来，谢谢老婆的提醒！”云金刚有些不好意思的说着。
这时候云柳氏走了回来，拉着云梦蝶的手问道：“宝贝孙女，小伙子答应了，明天晚上来赴宴吗？”
云梦蝶红着脸扑进了云柳氏的怀里，小声的说道：“奶奶，他答应了，明天晚上会来的。”
“哈哈哈，那就好，乖孙女，他那么优秀，你一定要抓住这个机会。俗话说；这个村就没有那个店！明白吗？”云柳氏很是开心，终于可以看到自己的宝贝孙女能够中意一个男子。
接着就向柳新梅发出命令：“新梅，明天晚上的晚宴不可以懈怠，必须以最高的规格来办，不得马虎！要是怠慢了我，未来的孙女婿，有你好看的。”
柳新梅连忙点头，“妈您放心，我一定安排妥当。”云开阳也说道：“此次请秦延军来，一是为了定他们俩的事，二也是想跟他背后的势力搞好关系，这对云家未来发展至关重要。”云金刚若有所思地点头。
云梦蝶心里既紧张又期待，她深知秦延军的优秀，也渴望能与他有个好结果。“爷爷，我明天穿什么衣服好呢？”云梦蝶拉着云开阳的胳膊撒娇。云开阳笑着说：“挑件漂亮的，把咱孙女的气质都展现出来。”
而此时的秦延军，对云家的这番安排还一无所知，他只是想着既然答应了，便去赴宴便是。但这场晚宴，注定不会风平浪静，云家的算盘能否如意，秦延军又会作何反应，一切都充满了未知。
第二天，秦延军接到大师姐的电话，告知云家也邀请了她一同赴宴。秦延军虽有些意外，但也没多想。
夜幕降临，秦延军和大师姐来到云家。云家上下张灯结彩，宾客云集。云梦蝶身着一袭白色晚礼服，宛如仙子般站在门口迎接。她看到秦延军，脸颊绯红，紧张地绞着手指。
晚宴开始，云开阳率先开口，表达了对秦延军的欣赏和对云梦蝶的疼爱，随后便提及了两人的婚事。
秦延军还没来得及回应，突然，吴茉莉开口说道：“云老爷子，我也看好云梦蝶这孩子，年纪轻轻就当上了总裁。今天，我师傅不在，这件喜事我就替他老人家做主了，让秦延军和云梦蝶两人正式相处。当然，如果我小师弟达不到梦蝶姑娘的要求，随时可以提出来，我们没有意见。”
云家众人听了吴茉莉的话，皆是一愣。云开阳很快反应过来，脸上堆满笑容，“吴总裁这话在理，秦小友一表人才，和我孙女很是般配。”

秦延军心中有些无奈，他对这婚事还没仔细考虑过，可现在被吴茉莉这么一说，场面变得有些骑虎难下。
云梦蝶则是又羞又喜，眼神含情脉脉地看向秦延军。
就在这时，云家大门突然被推开，一个身着黑衣的神秘人走了进来。他目光冰冷，扫视一圈后，径直走向秦延军，冷冷道：“秦延军，你跟我走一趟，有些旧账该算算了。”
众人皆惊，不知道这神秘人是谁，又和秦延军有何恩怨。云家众人紧张起来，生怕影响了这场晚宴的进程和秦延军与云梦蝶的婚事。秦延军眉头一皱，站起身来，准备面对这突如其来的状况，一场未知的风波就此在云家晚宴上掀起。
秦延军说道：“有什么事同我到外面去说，打起来损坏物品你赔不起。”
说完，便径直朝着外面走去，神秘黑衣人也跟在其后。
走了几步，秦延军又停下脚步，回头说道：“大师姐，你照顾好他们，不要让他们出来，我会处理好的。”
大师姐点了点头，神情严肃。云家众人虽担忧，但也只能听从秦延军的安排。
到了外面，神秘黑衣人冷冷开口：“秦延军，你忘了当年你在那座古秘之地坏我好事，让我失去晋升之机？今日我便要讨回这笔债。”
秦延军恍然大悟，想起了几年前的那次经历。他神色平静，“当年是你心术不正，为夺宝物滥杀无辜，我不过是出手阻止。”
神秘黑衣人怒极，大喝一声便朝秦延军扑来，拳风带起呼呼风声。秦延军侧身一闪，抬手便是一道灵力掌印拍出。两人瞬间交手数回合，周围尘土飞扬。
就在这时，远处突然传来一阵尖锐的呼啸声，紧接着一群神秘高手现身，将他们团团围住。黑衣人脸上露出得意之色，“秦延军，今日你插翅难逃。”
秦延军眼神一凛，握紧拳头，准备迎接这更为棘手的局面，心中思索着如何破局，保护好云家众人和自己。
秦延军心中虽有些紧张，但面上依旧镇定。他环顾四周，发现这些神秘高手身上散发着诡异的气息，显然不是普通角色。就在他思索对策时，大师姐带着云家几位高手冲了出来。原来，大师姐见秦延军许久未归，放心不下便出来查看。
神秘黑衣人见状，冷哼道：“来得正好，一起解决。”说罢，指挥着那群神秘高手一拥而上。秦延军和大师姐等人背靠背站在一起，共同迎敌。一时间，刀光剑影，灵力四溢。
战斗中，秦延军逐渐发现这些神秘高手的破绽，他巧妙地利用灵力，将他们的攻击一一化解。
就在众人激战正酣时，天空突然闪过一道强光，紧接着一位白发老者现身。老者目光如炬，扫视一圈后，大喝一声：“都给我住手！”
众人皆被这声呵斥震住，纷纷停下手中动作。老者看向秦延军，微笑道：“小家伙，别来无恙啊。”
秦延军定睛一看，惊喜道：“前辈，是您！”一场危机似乎有了转机。

Qin Yanjun gave up the idea of returning to his master, and then changed places and sat down.
Yun family.
Yun Mengdie hung up the phone and said happily: "Grandpa, Qin Yanjun agreed to come over for the banquet tomorrow night. Can you tell me what's going on now?"
The old man Yun Kaiyang looked at his granddaughter's eager look and suppressed a smile and said: "I want him to come over and settle the matter between you two. Since he has agreed, I will invite his senior sisters to come to the banquet tomorrow night. Qin Yanjun's parents have disappeared and are nowhere to be found. So far, he has not recognized his grandfather, so we can only invite his senior sisters to come over as witnesses."
Yun Jingang said: "Dad! Four of his senior brothers and sisters got together two days ago. The one who lives in the capital has gone back. The two presidents of Roewe Group are both his senior sisters and brothers. Should we invite one or two?"
Liu Xinmei knocked him on the head: "I said that you are the chairman, are you confused? Of course, he told his senior sister about this matter. It is naturally their own arrangement for how many people they come. Could it be? Are you going to force a few people to come?"
"Madam, I am also concerned about our daughter, and my head didn't turn around for a moment. Thank you for reminding me!" Yun Jingang said with some embarrassment.
At this time, Mrs. Yun Liu came back, took Yun Mengdie's hand and asked: "My dear granddaughter, the young man agreed, will you come to the banquet tomorrow night?"
Yunmengdie blushed and threw herself into Mrs. Yunliu's arms, and whispered: "Grandma, he promised that he will come tomorrow night."
"Hahaha, that's good, my dear granddaughter, he is so good, you must seize this opportunity. As the saying goes, there is no such shop in this village! Do you understand?" Mrs. Yunliu was very happy, finally seeing her precious granddaughter fall in love with a man.
Then he issued an order to Liu Xinmei: "Xinmei, you can't slack off on tomorrow night's dinner. It must be held to the highest standards and can't be sloppy! If you neglect me, your future grandson-in-law will look good on you."
Liu Xinmei nodded quickly, "Don't worry, Mom, I will definitely make the arrangements." Yun Kaiyang also said: "I invited Qin Yanjun here this time, firstly, to settle matters between the two of them, and secondly, to establish a good relationship with the forces behind him, which is crucial to the future development of the Yun family." Yun Jinjiang nodded thoughtfully.
Yun Mengdie was nervous and looking forward to it. She knew Qin Yanjun's excellence well and was eager to have a good result with him. "Grandpa, what should I wear tomorrow?" Yun Mengdie took Yun Kaiyang's arm and acted coquettishly. Yun Kaiyang said with a smile: "Choose something beautiful to show off our granddaughter's temperament."
At this time, Qin Yanjun didn't know anything about the Yun family's arrangement. He just thought that since he agreed, he would go to the banquet. But this dinner is destined to not be peaceful. Whether the Yun family's plan will go as they wish, and how Qin Yanjun will react, everything is full of unknowns.
The next day, Qin Yanjun received a call from the eldest sister, telling her that the Yun family had also invited her to the banquet. Although Qin Yanjun was a little surprised, he didn't think much about it.
As night fell, Qin Yanjun and the senior sister came to the Yun family. The Yun family was decorated with lanterns and colorful decorations, and guests gathered. Yun Mengdie was wearing a white evening dress and stood at the door like a fairy to greet her. When she saw Qin Yanjun, her cheeks were flushed and she was wringing her fingers nervously.
At the beginning of the dinner, Yun Kaiyang spoke first, expressing his appreciation for Qin Yanjun and his love for Yun Mengdie, and then mentioned their marriage.
Before Qin Yanjun had time to respond, Wu Moli suddenly said: "Mr. Yun, I am also optimistic about this kid Yun Mengdie, who has become the president at a young age. Today, my master is not here, so I will take the decision of this happy event for him, so that Qin Yanjun and Yun Mengdie can officially get along. Of course, if my junior brother cannot meet the requirements of Miss Mengdie, I can always ask for it.Come on, we have no problem with that. "
Everyone in the Yun family was stunned after hearing Wu Moli's words. Yun Kaiyang reacted quickly, with a smile on his face, "President Wu's words are reasonable. Qin Xiaoyou is a talented person and is a perfect match for my granddaughter. "
Qin Yanjun felt a little helpless. He had not thought about the marriage carefully, but now that Wu Moli said this, the situation became a bit difficult to get out of.
Yun Mengdie was both shy and happy, looking at Qin Yanjun with affection in her eyes.
At this moment, the door of the Yun family was suddenly pushed open, and a mysterious man dressed in black walked in. His eyes were cold, and after scanning around, he walked straight towards Qin Yanjun and said coldly: "Qin Yanjun, come with me, some old scores should be settled. "
Everyone was shocked, wondering who this mysterious man was and what grudge he had with Qin Yanjun. Everyone in the Yun family became nervous, fearing that it would affect the progress of the dinner and the marriage between Qin Yanjun and Yun Mengdie. Qin Yanjun frowned and stood up, preparing to face this unexpected situation. An unknown storm started at the Yun family dinner.
Qin Yanjun said: "If you have anything to do, tell me outside. You can't afford to pay for the damage caused by the fight. "
After saying that, he walked straight outside, followed by the mysterious man in black.
After walking a few steps, Qin Yanjun stopped again, turned around and said, "Sister, take care of them and don't let them come out, I will take care of it. "
The senior sister nodded, her expression serious. Although everyone in the Yun family was worried, they could only follow Qin Yanjun's arrangements.
Outside, the mysterious man in black said coldly: "Qin Yanjun, have you forgotten that you ruined my good deeds in that ancient and mysterious place and made me lose the chance of promotion? Today I want to collect this debt. "
Qin Yanjun suddenly realized and remembered the experience a few years ago. He looked calm, "Back then, you had evil intentions and killed innocent people indiscriminately to seize treasures. I just stepped in to stop you. "
The mysterious man in black was so angry that he shouted loudly and rushed towards Qin Yanjun, the wind of his fist making a whirring sound. Qin Yanjun dodged sideways, raised his hand and shot out a spiritual palm print. The two of them fought for several rounds in an instant, with dust flying around them.
At this moment, a sharp whistling sound suddenly came from the distance, and then a group of mysterious masters appeared and surrounded them. The man in black had a proud look on his face, "Qin Yanjun, you can't escape today. "
Qin Yanjun's eyes flashed, and he clenched his fists, preparing to face this more difficult situation. He was thinking about how to break the situation and protect the Yun family and himself.
Although Qin Yanjun was a little nervous, his face remained calm. He looked around and found that these mysterious masters exuded strange auras and were obviously not ordinary characters. Just as he was thinking about countermeasures, the senior sister rushed out with several experts from the Yun family. It turned out that the senior sister was worried when she saw that Qin Yanjun had not returned for a long time, so she came out to check.
Seeing this, the mysterious man in black snorted coldly: "We've come just in time, let's solve it together. "After that, he commanded the group of mysterious masters to swarm forward. Qin Yanjun, Senior Sister and others stood back to back and faced the enemy together. For a moment, the light of swords and shadows of swords and spiritual power overflowed.
During the battle, Qin Yanjun gradually discovered the flaws of these mysterious masters. He skillfully used his spiritual power to resolve their attacks one by one.
Just when everyone was fighting fiercely, a bright light suddenly flashed in the sky, and then a white-haired old man appeared. The old man's eyes were as bright as fire, and after scanning around, he shouted: "Stop it! "
Everyone was shocked by the scolding and stopped their movements. The old man looked at Qin Yanjun and said with a smile: "You're fine, little guy. "
Qin Yanjun took a closer look and said in surprise: "Senior, it's you! "A crisis seems to have turned around.
